plugins.name: bulk-image-generation
plugins.description: Orchestrated bulk AI image generation via Pollinations.ai with live HTML dashboard, seed-based recovery, and optional user API key. Claude Code asks for (or composes) a professional prompt, asks whether to use the public API or your own key (setup via a local web form), runs a Python helper that hits Pollinations sequentially, saves images to disk, writes a self-refreshing dashboard.html you open via file://, and emits JSON-lines events to stdout so the Monitor tool can stream progress. Includes --recover and --from run.json modes for re-fetching previously generated images from the server cache without burning new generations.
